testEnvironment: Real renderer in event-capable DOM. Actual editor and media controller combined for draft/selection/player/mode-exit checks. HTTP fixture tests use actual 404/404/200 responses with simulated DOM load events. Separate real browser smoke loads valid synthetic SVG/WAV/WebM, retries missing files through UI, saves and reloads.
limitations: DOM load/error events are simulated; the HTTP MP4/WAV fixtures only establish route/byte preservation, not codec support.
Real browser verifies SVG natural dimensions and WAV/WebM loaded data with paused state, but no play/seek or output-device/audio checks were performed.
Offline resources were modeled by moving synthetic files; actual external-drive reconnection and Tauri native windows were not exercised.
Rust and the two native archive test groups were not rerun.
